division_of_labour.inference_and_eval_side: research-extractor (all model hosting, serving flags, cache metrics, GPUs)
division_of_labour.harness_side: Consonance (context compiler, manifest, authority, audit, fixtures, offline economics)

units.title: CACHE-BOUNDARY-SWEEP
units.question: How does cache reuse depend on where a rewrite lands?
units.falsifier: reuse is not monotone in rewrite offset, so rewrite depth is not a predictor

units.title: CHECKPOINT-COST
units.question: What does one compaction checkpoint cost and over how many steps does it repay?
units.falsifier: not repaid within 20 steps when measured as uncached work
units.unblocks: whether immutable branches + checkpoint/fork are worth building at all

units.title: ORDERING
units.question: Same modules, different order: does the cached/uncached split change?
units.falsifier: no measurable difference at equal token count
units.unblocks: whether the admission objective gains a positional term

units.title: 32K-DENSE-TIER
units.question: Is a 32768-token dense route a usable cheap tier for long tasks?
units.falsifier: verified success collapses on the subset that needs paging
units.unblocks: whether the harness has a tier-selection policy and what its floor is

units.title: HYBRID-REUSE-ELIGIBILITY
units.question: On a hybrid attention/SSM model, what is the deepest safe prefix boundary?
units.falsifier: boundary is all-or-nothing, or reported reuse exceeds a provably shorter shared prefix
units.unblocks: whether branch reuse can be modelled in tokens at all

units.title: EXP48-CONTROL-REPAIR
units.question: Does demand paging help once the controls can report the opposite?
units.falsifier: a control cannot be made to report the opposite, making the arm void
units.unblocks: whether EXPAND(ref) is a real mechanism or a plausible story

deliverables_expected_back: run.json per arm, frozen before the first call
NDJSON call rows per INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md section 2
control table stated separately from the primary result
one-page verdict naming what fired, what did not, and the falsifier verdict
itemised costs paid (rebuild, warm, staging, eviction)
deliverables_owed_by_consonance: two golden replay fixtures reproduced byte-identically offline
rules: absent provider counters are unknown, never zero
no arm comparable across differing model/tokenizer/renderer/engine fingerprints
no promotion of unregistered reconnaissance into a quoted finding
no touching the production container; restore verified via /v1/models
controls must be shown able to report the opposite before a primary run
